manual.slag_products.line2: {0}§2Slag Gravel§r is slag that has been ground in the {1}Crusher{2} to a rough grit. As with other gravels, it can be crushed further into sand.{3}
manual.slag_products.line3: Additionally, slag gravel contains valuable nutrients for aquatic flora. Waterlogged plants placed on slag gravel grow faster than when grown on other blocks.{0}
manual.slag_products.line4: {0}Remelting slag in a §2Furnace§r vitrifies it to a hard, darkened §2slag glass§r.{1}
manual.slag_products.line5: This glass reduces the strength of light passing through it and can be used as an insulator in {0}high-voltage relays{1}.
manual.slag_products.line6: {0}§2Slag Bricks§r are slag shaped into bricks similar in most respects to clay bricks.{1}
manual.slag_products.line7: The ceramic in slag bricks is tougher than that of standard clay bricks, able to withstand explosions more readily.{0}
manual.slag_products.line8: Slag Bricks can be formed into stairs, slabs, and walls, which have a small sill of baked brick on the top-most layer.
